question: ip-proxy/anchoredip-registration-corrected: record the type and registrant of the parent block 194.0.108.0 - 194.0.111.255 and rewrite candidate (3) of the notes, which says the walk to its LIR was not run.
why: RIPE RDAP read on 2026-11-02 (https://rdap.db.ripe.net/ip/194.0.108.0/22) returns that block as type ALLOCATED PA, country KZ, parentHandle 0.0.0.0 - 255.255.255.255 and registrant lir-kz-individual-1-MNT, the registrant handle of the 194.0.109.0/24 assignment. So the block is an allocation held by the same registrant, not a block resold from a larger carrier, and extras.parent_block holds only the range. A verify unit should capture that URL, add the type and registrant as fields, and update the notes. The answer also carries a private person's name, address and phone number: quote only the type, handle and parentHandle fields.
